text_block_list.text:
—Summer Training Camp.
For these still-developing Umamusume,
a season of monumental growth begins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
S-S-Summer training camp!? This is bad,
this is really bad, Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean...? Summer training camp means *that*, right?
Packed full of heart-throbbing situations...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Swimming together in our swimsuits, sharing a ramune,
watching fireworks in our yukatas..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And in the end, the two of them... Aaaaah!
No matter what, surely, surely they wouldn't go th-th-that far...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Sorry, I was just letting my delusions...
I mean, imagination run wild~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've lived my whole life without knowing about things like this.
Even though I've focused straight on sports the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So all sorts of crazy thoughts,
real and imagined, keep popping into my head. Aaaahhh...!!
...Fidgeting and brooding. I get the feeling she might have the wrong idea about summer training camp, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "If I end up meeting someone, what on earth should I do?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Please coach me, Trainer!
How do I get a conversation going
without talking about muscles!?

...The bar is set quite high.
Still, this is the perfect opportunity.

The spring Classics were one fierce battle after another.
I want to help her refresh herself during this summer training camp.
